'''Shadows of the Empire''' is a cancelled Decipher expansion (CardGuide #33). It was scheduled for August 2000 as a mini-expansion of about 20 cards based on the novel of the same name. The novel is set between ''The Empire Strikes Back'' and ''Return of the Jedi''. Decipher placed that story arc between [[Cloud City Limited]] and [[Jabba's Palace Limited]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 March 2005)</ref>

The Death Star II starter-deck rulebook advertised it as the next expansion, featuring Prince Xizor, Dash Rendar, their starships, and photo-realistic art.<ref name="ds2rb">Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook advertisement, reproduced on [[Cancelled Expansions]].</ref> Many of those card concepts shipped instead as unique premiums in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] (including [[Prince Xizor]], [[Dash Rendar]], [[Guri]], [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]], [[Outrider]], [[Stinger]], and [[Virago]]).<ref name="encyc" />

No retail packaging was released.
